 Founded in 1959 The Main Resource® has evolved into a leading supplier of Automotive Service Equipment Replacement Parts and Automotive Aftermarket Products. The Main Resource supplies a diverse combination of product lines to the Automotive Industry providing a One Stop Shop experience for all customers. In addition, the manufacturing partnerships have provided The Main Resource with the ability to purchase molds and toolings that have produced products at substantial cost saving to The Main Resource customers.
